# History

- The instruction surface was reorganized around a compact global risk core, a deep shared workflow, thin authorization adapters, and progressive disclosure.
- The former PR-diagnosis thinning specifications are superseded because their focused rules now sit inside this broader architecture and shared references.
- Public legacy planning aliases were removed while historical evidence remains readable through migration compatibility.
- ADR relationships are indexed by the owning `SPEC.md`; this history retains only the instruction architecture's local adoption record.
